_comment:
Cortex Phase 3 merge & verify pipeline — 5 nodes total.

Phase 3 runs after Phase 2 execution agents pass the human gate. It
verifies the code (tester runs pytest), creates a PR (pr_creator),
reviews it (reviewer issues APPROVE/REJECT), pauses at a human gate
(gate-phase3), then merges (pr_merger).

Critical: pr_merger uses GH_TOKEN_MERGE (rlagowski) — a different
GitHub user from the code authors — enforcing token separation per
project design. This is passed via runtime_config.env.

The gate node (gate-phase3) uses cortex.dap_steps.human_gate:noop — a
pass-through that does nothing. The actual pause is driven by the engine
via interrupt_before when approval_required_nodes includes 'gate-phase3'.
The operator approves with:
  POST /runs/{id}/nodes/gate-phase3/approve
or simply:
  POST /runs/{id}/resume

Ref: rafeekpro/dap#164 (interrupt_before + /approve endpoint)

pipeline.name: Cortex Phase 3 — Merge & Verify
pipeline.description: Phase 3 pipeline: tester → pr-creator → reviewer → gate-phase3 → pr-merger. Verifies code, creates PR, reviews, gates for human approval, then merges with a separate token (GH_TOKEN_MERGE).

install_instructions.summary: Import this bundle into a DAP engine that has cortex-project installed.
steps: 1. Ensure cortex-project is installed in the DAP engine venv: uv add --path /path/to/cortex-project
2. Set CORTEX_ env vars (GH_TOKEN_READ, GH_TOKEN_ISSUES, GH_TOKEN_CODE, GH_TOKEN_MERGE, DATABASE_URL)
3. Strip _comment and install_instructions before importing: POST /pipelines/import with {schema_version, pipeline, bundled_agents}
4. Create a run: POST /runs with pipeline_id and initial_state.extensions={issue_url, issue_number, repo, branch, ...}
5. Phase 3 starts with tester (runs pytest against agent branch), then pr-creator opens a GitHub PR
6. reviewer issues APPROVE/REJECT, then run pauses at gate-phase3 for human approval
8. pr-merger merges the PR using GH_TOKEN_MERGE (rlagowski — separate user from code authors)
install_instructions.gate_design: gate-phase3 uses interrupt_before (approval_required_nodes) NOT a python-func that calls POST /pause. This avoids the infinite pause loop described in rafeekpro/dap#164. The gate-phase3 node itself is a no-op (cortex.dap_steps.human_gate:noop) that executes only after the operator approves.
